services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Looking for the perfect venue for your next gathering? The Town of Gore Bay offers a variety of rental spaces to suit any occasion, from community celebrations and corporate meetings to weddings and special events. Our well-maintained facilities provide modern amenities in a charming setting, ensuring a seamless experience for you and your guests. Whether you need a spacious hall, a meeting room, or an outdoor venue with stunning waterfront views, we have options to fit your needs. Explore our rental spaces and book your ideal venue today! services.name: Healthcare and Clinics
services.desc: The Gore Bay Medical Centre is a cornerstone of health and wellness in our Town, providing top-quality care with a warm, community-focused approach. Located at the 70 Meredith Street, our dedicated team of healthcare professionals ensures that residents and visitors alike have access to exceptional medical services close to home. Together, they offer compassionate, expert care that people across western Manitoulin rely on. In addition, specialists and practitioners, use the Gore Bay Medical Centre on a part-time basis, ensuring that residents have access to experts on all medical issues.
